title: Former Steelers QB signs with UFL team

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Former Steelers QB signs with UFL team
sources.description: The Pittsburgh Steelers released QB/WR John Rhys Plumlee last week, and now the former UCF star has found a home in the UFL. Per UFL communications, Plumlee has signed with the Houston Gamblers.
